title: Hidden History
description: This datapack adds the charming Moobloom and three dangerous new jockeys: Dolphin with Drowned, Ocelot with Baby Zombie, and Piglin riding a Hoglin.
body:
![Hidden History’s Mobs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb61b07925c995c810a24ca57e34d3eac553ea80_0.webp)

In the image, you can see all of the Hidden History datapack mobs.

Moobloom – A peaceful cow that leaves a trail of flowers as it moves through plains and sunflower biomes, adding a touch of life and charm to your environment.

Dolphin Jockey – A Drowned riding a dolphin, creating a fast and deadly aquatic threat.

Ocelot Jockey – A baby zombie riding an ocelot, blending speed and aggression for a surprising melee challenge.

Piglin Jockey – A Piglin carrying a spear while riding a Hoglin, appearing only in the Nether as a heavy-hitting and dangerous enemy.

This datapack requires a resource pack, as well as the Entity Model Features Mod and Entity Texture Features Mod, which provide all the custom models and textures needed for the mobs to display correctly.

Perfect for players seeking new exploration experiences, combat challenges, and unique mob interactions, this datapack lays the foundation for future updates, with more mobs and content planned to continually enrich your world.
